movement_scope: Author server-side Forge FakePlayer physical collision probes. Each target restarts at the declared route origin; all intermediate movement uses Entity.move with horizontal displacement and downward gravity probe, native automatic step-up, no positive-Y injection or waypoint teleport. Ladder uses Player.travel forward into supported ladder and lateral travel onto upper platform. Calls execute synchronously, not real client input or a complete survival movement tick loop; no packet, human, jump or rotation certification. Menu use after route is native block.use from reached feet but does not certify client raycast.
